execution.raw_text:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id AS chembl_id,
    md.pref_name AS pref_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles,
    di.efo_id AS indication_curie,
    di.efo_term AS indication_label,
    di.max_phase_for_ind AS max_phase_for_ind
FROM molecule_dictionary md
INNER JOIN drug_indication di
    ON md.molregno = di.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs
    ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE md.therapeutic_flag = 1
  AND di.max_phase_for_ind = 4
  AND di.efo_id = 'EFO:0000404'
  AND di.efo_term = 'infection'
ORDER BY
    chembl_id,
    pref_name,
    canonical_smiles,
    indication_curie,
    indication_label,
    max_phase_for_ind;
```
